honest: Validation PR-AUC is 0.151 against a base rate of 0.066 — about 2.3× better than guessing, with ROC-AUC 0.688. That is a useful ranking signal, not a pocket detector: the model surfaces plausible regions, and the top residues are enriched for real contacts, but it will also light up hydrophobic patches that bind nothing. Labels come from whatever ligand was crystallised with each structure, so a residue marked negative may still be part of a pocket for some other molecule.
